summary: Two Stack comments state input guarantees that the implementation does not fully establish or document.

items.issue: The constructor documentation omits that `ArrayDeque.alloc(initialSize)` rejects negative (and excessively large) capacity hints with `IllegalArgumentException`.
items.suggestion: Add an `@throws IllegalArgumentException` tag describing invalid `initialSize` values.

items.issue: The comment says `array` is allocated by `ArrayDeque.alloc`, but the body only passes it to the constructor. The inherited contract requires a power-of-two-length array; it does not require that allocator.
items.suggestion: Document the actual requirement: the backing array length must be a power of two, without claiming it was allocated by `ArrayDeque.alloc`.
